evidence.quote: For over 50 years we have been specialising in the trade of meat, in particular poultry, beef, pork and fish distributed by the Meat division || we operate in more than 70 countries on 5 continents, providing you with a team of professionals able to offer assistance at any time || allow us to supply top-level players, such as national and international supermarkets.
